name: Stories
title: Stories | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Turn source material into stories people can use.
description: Bring the notes, evidence, and audience. Develop a presentation, document, or storyboard, then read it, comment on it, and refine the result with your agent.
alt: Stories presentation review workspace showing a generated product story with contextual feedback.
caption: The real Stories workspace reviewing a presentation it generated about its own development.
flow_title: From the material to something worth reading.
flow_intro: Start with what you know and who needs to understand it. Keep the evidence connected to the story.
steps: Supply source text, distinguish facts from hypotheses, and describe the audience and purpose. Stories plans and creates a draft.
Review the actual slides or document. Select text or an element to leave a comment, and allow a bounded round of answers or revisions.
Choose a specific revision. Export presentations as HTML or a media ZIP, and documents as HTML, PDF, or editable Word.
detail_title: The conversation stays with the work.
details: Feedback sits beside the material it describes. New revisions remain separate from the one you are reading.
Review source references, quotations, supported calculations, and material changes alongside the draft.
Develop storyboards with supplied images, compare alternatives, and export structured panels with their brief and viewer.
prompt: Use Stories to turn my project notes into a short presentation for engineering leaders. Read stories --help, help me configure a provider, and keep claims grounded in the supplied material. Open the draft for review and a bounded round of refinement.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, Git, uv, and Pango for text layout. Video exports additionally need FFmpeg and FFprobe.
model_note: Generation needs separately configured model access through Amplifier Agent. Reading retained work and recording acceptance need no model.
